handoff_focus: Balanced phase2-vs-rest BCE plus actual-onset mean squared world-y/.05m, yaw/.05rad, world-vy/.1m_s; unchanged stopping thresholds
joint_displacement_normalization: RMS one-step quadrature defect from within-rollout TRAIN pairs only; zero initialized head
entry_exposure: 50percent TRAIN true-start batches replaced by frozen upstream estimated physical/history; DEV true and predicted starts both scored
lock_scales: hip/knee0.01rad and0.1rad/s at actual transition labels
handoff_loss: Mean normalized physical error at actual phase2 transition, weight1; labels only, not rollout inputs
selection: DEV mean normalized multistep physical/history/contact/phase loss, including transition and endpoint weighting; decision-quality evaluation still required
initialization: model and Adam resume; new sampling RNG
device: GPU model and resident tensors; scalar/trajectory transfers only at checkpoint evaluation
stop: finite updates or outer25min wall budget; no automatic extension
history: Predicted controller/RB estimates after initial state; no measured future injected
